column3: NASB follows the critical text (repeated “from where”), rendered “What is the source … ? Is not the source …”; “passions” is rendered “pleasures.”
NASB follows the critical text, without “now”; it supplies “so” twice and renders “kill” as “commit murder.”
NASB follows the critical text (“You adulteresses,” without “adulterers and”); “is appointed” is rendered “makes himself.”
NASB follows the critical text (“He has made to dwell”); it treats “the Spirit” as the object of “jealously desires.” The meaning is uncertain.
NASB adds “a”; the quotation is in capitals.
NASB follows the critical text (“or judges”); it adds “of it.”
NASB follows the critical text (“and Judge,” “your neighbor”); it adds “only.”
NASB follows the critical text (“Today or tomorrow,” future verbs); “trade” is rendered “engage in business.”
NASB follows the critical text; “a vapor” is rendered “just a vapor,” and NASB supplies “will be like.”
NASB follows the critical text (“we shall live and also do”).
